name: @composable-os/pack-dailychecks
description: Daily checklists: checklists done on their own, without a roster (opening, closing, cleaning; ADR 0651). The screens over the host's checklist operations: today's checklists for whoever may do one (web and the app) and how each day went for those who manage checklists. Requires nothing. Bundled as source into cos-runner.

composableOs.label: Daily checklists
composableOs.description: Checklists on their own: opening, closing and cleaning, due on set days by a set time, ticked off by whoever may do them, with how each day went.
